trust_decision.summary: Image-config Env entries (attacker-controlled image metadata) are run through the user-facing env parser, which treats key-only entries ('NAME' / 'PREFIX*') as host-environment passthrough; the decision 'image env must be literal KEY=VALUE, never host lookup' belongs in CompleteSpec's image-env defaults step.

landing_point.why: Summary says 'podman run' + image env leaking host env; CompleteSpec is where image Config.Env is merged and the only image-env call into envLib.ParseSlice.

fix_sites.entry_point: new helper generate.ParseImageEnvs (public func in pkg/specgen/generate)
podman run / podman create / podman container clone / pod create infra / libpod REST containers/create / kube play, all via generate.CompleteSpec

O3_reason_to_dismiss: kube.ToSpecGen's own loop uses strings.Cut and never consults the host env, and kube play still goes through CompleteSpec (pkg/domain/infra/abi/play.go:1010,1106), so a solver can rightly argue the kube site is not a leak and the CompleteSpec fix alone already covers kube play.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Key-only and 'PREFIX*' host passthrough is a legitimate feature for user-supplied --env, --env-file, podman exec --env and containers.conf env; changing the shared parseEnv/ParseSlice to reject or ignore key-only entries breaks all of them.

O6_input_shapes: prefix glob 'HOST*' (all host vars with that prefix)

O7_producer.where: image Config.Env comes from libimage Inspect (vendored c/common), consumed directly at pkg/specgen/generate/container.go:59,177

O8b_injection_room.sibling: --env-merge expansion seeded from image env parsed with the passthrough-capable parser instead of the strict one
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: env-merge already reuses defaultEnvs built from image env; a maintainer could plausibly re-parse inspectData.Config.Env there with envLib.ParseSlice for 'image-only' substitution.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: infra-container spec path that merges infra image Env via envLib.ParseSlice before calling CompleteSpec
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: infra spec is assembled separately from user container specs; duplicating the env-defaults block there is a natural copy.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: podman exec defaulting to the image's Config.Env and feeding it through envLib.ParseSlice alongside --env
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: exec already parses CLI env with ParseSlice; adding image env defaults with the same call looks like a harmless convenience.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: HOW-type: a strict image-env parser that checks hasValue/empty key on the raw key while the consumer uses a trimmed key (or vice versa), creating a parser differential on the key's identity
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: parseEnv already checks key == "" before TrimLeft'ing it (pkg/env/env.go:95-99), so check-then-normalise ordering bugs of this kind are natural.

O9_family: CWE-200 information exposure: untrusted metadata interpreted with a trusted-input parser (host environment passthrough)

O10_build.toolchain: Go toolchain per go.mod; cgo build of pkg/specgen/generate needs Linux headers/libs (libseccomp, gpgme, btrfs or exclude tags) due to '!remote && (linux || freebsd)' build tags
O10_build.project_tests: Fix adds unit test pkg/specgen/generate/container_test.go (TestParseImageEnvs) and bats test/system/030-run.bats 'podman run host env leak' (needs skopeo, jq, a container runtime); neither exists at the pinned commit, and pkg/env/env.go:4 notes 'TODO: we need to add tests for this package'.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Make pkg/env parseEnv reject or drop key-only / '*' entries globally, which closes the leak but breaks --env NAME, --env 'PREFIX*', --env-file and containers.conf passthrough.

out_of_scope_notes: Vendored buildah/c-common also process image Env during podman build; not checked, outside this repo's own code.
